name: chainlink-staking-ledger-parity
description: Cross-warehouse parity check: BigQuery marts vs Databricks Delta tables. Runs daily after the reconciliation_check Airflow DAG. Critical-mart diffs fail; informational-mart diffs alert only.

tasks.description: Read GCS parquet for the 7-day comparison window into Delta tables.
Compare each mart row-by-row between BigQuery and Delta. Critical mismatches fail the job.
